posts.name: Johnson Philips
posts.cooked:
@Puneet_21f3002005

Can I do ssh-keygen separately on 2 machines and set up the VMs on each(by uploading the respective public keys ?
Or can I copy the private key from the first PC I setup the VM, to the second computer, and use the ssh -i with path and username@host, without doing the ssh-keygen on the second computer (if this is allowed, the keys are not generated machine specific i guess).

Kindly advise.

Thanks,

posts.name: Harsh Shah
posts.cooked: Copy the public key and private key pair. Paste it in the .ssh directory of the second system. And login the same way using a terminal. It’ll work

posts.name: Johnson Philips
posts.cooked: Thanks, I will try that this evening.
